note: English B1 reading rounds in the Cambridge B1 Preliminary format (owner's plan 2026-10-30). Parts 1–6: five short texts (3 options), five people matched to eight texts (en_people), a long text (4 options), a gapped text — five of eight sentences (en_gapped), a multiple-choice cloze (4 options), an open cloze (en_open, typed). Original texts. Drafted in tools/.mockups/en_b1.py.

items.text:
Jake —
The football club meeting has moved from Thursday to Friday because the room is being painted. It still starts at 7.
Coach Davies

tr.zh:
傑克：
因為房間在油漆，足球社的會議從星期四改到星期五，還是七點開始。
戴維斯教練

questions.q: What is the coach telling Jake?
options: The meeting will be on a different day.
Jake needs to help paint the room.
questions.zh: 會議「從星期四改到星期五」，時間「還是七點」：只有日子改了。
questions.en: Thursday to Friday, still at 7: only the day changes.

items.text:
Photos are welcome in all galleries except the Egyptian Room.
Please do not use flash anywhere in the museum.

tr.zh:
除了埃及展廳，所有展廳都歡迎拍照。
館內任何地方都請勿使用閃光燈。

options: You cannot take any photos in the museum.
You may take photos without flash in most rooms.
Flash is allowed only in the Egyptian Room.
questions.zh: 除了埃及展廳都可以拍照，但哪裡都不能用閃光燈：大部分展廳可以拍不開閃光燈的照片。
questions.en: Most rooms allow photos, never with flash.

items.text:
Hi Priya,
I've left the keys with Mrs Lee next door. The plumber is coming at 3, so could you be home to let him in? I'll be back by 6.
Dad

tr.zh:
普莉亞：
鑰匙放在隔壁李太太那裡。水電工三點會來，你可以在家幫他開門嗎？我六點前回來。
爸爸

questions.q: Why did Dad write the message?
options: to ask Priya to let someone into the house
to ask Priya to fix something
to tell Priya he has lost the keys
questions.zh: 「你可以在家幫他開門嗎」：請她讓水電工進門；鑰匙沒有丟，是放在鄰居家。
questions.en: Let the plumber in; the keys are with the neighbour.

items.text:
From 1 June, members can bring a friend for free on Sundays.
Friends must sign in at reception and be over 16.

tr.zh:
六月一日起，會員星期天可以免費帶一位朋友。
朋友必須在櫃台登記，而且要滿十六歲。

options: Friends can use the gym free on any day.
Members' friends need to sign in.
questions.zh: 「朋友必須在櫃台登記」；只有星期天免費，滿十六歲是對朋友的要求。
questions.en: Friends sign in; free only on Sundays; the age rule is for friends.

items.text:
Mum,
The concert finished early, so I'm getting the 9.15 train instead of the 10.30 one. No need to pick me up — Ellie's dad will drive me home from the station.

tr.zh:
媽：
演唱會提早結束，所以我搭九點十五分的火車，不搭十點半那班了。不用來接我，艾莉的爸爸會從車站載我回家。

options: Ellie will pick her up at 10.30.
She will get home earlier than planned.
She needs her mum to drive her.
questions.zh: 改搭九點十五分、不是十點半的火車：比原來早到家；也不用媽媽接。
questions.en: An earlier train, so home earlier; Mum needn't drive.

bank: Riverside Kayaking — A two-day beginners' course for families with children aged seven and over. All equipment is provided. Runs every week during the summer holidays.
World Kitchen — Saturday and Sunday classes where you learn recipes from Thailand, Mexico and Morocco. Bring a box: you can take your food home!
City Photo Walks — Explore the city's buildings with a professional photographer. Groups of up to 25. Weekday mornings only.
Island Nature Photography — A week on Puffin Island photographing seabirds and seals, with expert advice. A maximum of eight people per group.
Evening Guitar Club — Complete beginners welcome. Lessons every Tuesday and Thursday from 7 to 9 p.m. Guitars can be borrowed.
Park Runners — Meet other runners every Saturday morning in Green Park. It is completely free, and all levels are welcome.
Morning Piano Lessons — Private lessons with an experienced teacher, Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 1 p.m.
Family Rock Climbing — For experienced climbers aged twelve and over. Please bring your own equipment.

tr.zh:
A 河邊獨木舟：兩天的初學者課程，適合有七歲以上孩子的家庭，提供所有裝備，暑假每週開課。
B 世界廚房：週六、週日上課，學泰國、墨西哥、摩洛哥菜，帶個盒子，做好的菜可以帶回家。
C 城市攝影散步：跟專業攝影師拍城市建築，每團最多二十五人，只在平日上午。
D 海島自然攝影：在海鸚島待一週拍海鳥和海豹，有專家指導，每團最多八人。
E 晚間吉他社：歡迎完全的初學者，每週二、四晚上七點到九點，可以借吉他。
F 公園跑步團：每週六早上在綠園一起跑步，完全免費，各種程度都歡迎。
G 上午鋼琴課：資深老師一對一教學，週一到週五早上九點到下午一點。
H 親子攀岩：給十二歲以上、有經驗的攀岩者，請自備裝備。

questions.q: Maria wants to learn to cook dishes from other countries. She can only go at weekends, and she'd like to take home what she makes.
questions.zh: 瑪麗亞要學外國菜、只有週末有空、想把做的菜帶回家：B「世界廚房」三項都符合。
questions.en: World Kitchen: foreign recipes, weekends, take the food home.

questions.q: Tom and his eight-year-old son want to do something outdoors together in the school holidays. Neither of them has done it before.
questions.zh: 父子一起、暑假、都沒做過：A 是給有七歲以上孩子的家庭的初學者課程；H 要十二歲以上、有經驗。
questions.en: Riverside Kayaking: beginners, families with children 7+; H needs experience and age 12+.

questions.q: Lucy is a keen photographer who wants to improve her skills. She wants a course with no more than ten students, somewhere she can photograph wildlife.
questions.zh: 露西想拍野生動物、人數不超過十人：D 最多八人、拍海鳥和海豹；C 有二十五人，拍的是建築。
questions.en: Island Nature Photography: eight people, wildlife; C has 25 and buildings.

questions.q: Daniel wants to learn a musical instrument. He works during the day, so he can only go in the evenings.
questions.zh: 丹尼爾只有晚上有空：E 晚上七點到九點；G 鋼琴課在白天。
questions.en: Evening Guitar Club; the piano lessons are in the daytime.

questions.q: Hana wants to get fitter but doesn't like gyms. She'd like to meet new people, and it must not cost much.
questions.zh: 花不喜歡健身房、想認識新朋友、要便宜：F 在公園一起跑步，完全免費。
questions.en: Park Runners: outdoors, other people, free.

items.text:
When Rosa Martinez moved into a flat in the centre of town three years ago, she missed one thing more than anything else: her parents' garden. 'I grew up picking tomatoes and beans every summer,' she says. 'Suddenly I had nothing but a tiny balcony.'
Behind her building was an empty piece of land that had been a car park until the company that owned it closed. Rosa wrote to the town council to ask if local people could use it to grow vegetables. 'I didn't expect an answer,' she admits. 'But a month later they said yes — as long as we kept it tidy and didn't build anything permanent.'
The first spring was hard work. Rosa and a few neighbours spent every weekend removing stones and bringing in soil. 'Some people thought we were crazy,' she laughs. 'But when the first lettuces came up, more and more people wanted to join.' Today the garden has forty members, from schoolchildren to pensioners, and each family looks after its own small area.
The garden has changed the street in ways Rosa never imagined. 'People who had lived next to each other for years had never spoken,' she says. 'Now they share seeds, swap recipes and water each other's plants when someone is on holiday.' Last summer the members held their first harvest party, cooking meals with everything they had grown.
Rosa's next plan is to build a small greenhouse so that the garden can be used in winter too. 'We'll need to raise some money first,' she says, 'but after everything we've done, I'm sure we'll find a way.'

tr.zh:
三年前蘿莎·馬丁尼茲搬進市中心的公寓時，最想念的就是爸媽家的菜園。「我從小每年夏天都摘番茄、摘豆子，」她說，「突然間只剩一個小陽台。」
她住的大樓後面有一塊空地，原本是停車場，後來擁有它的公司倒了。蘿莎寫信給市議會，問附近居民能不能用來種菜。「我沒想到會有回音，」她承認，「但一個月後他們答應了，只要我們保持整潔、不蓋永久的建築。」
第一個春天很辛苦。蘿莎和幾個鄰居每個週末都在搬石頭、運土。「有人覺得我們瘋了，」她笑著說，「可是第一批萵苣長出來以後，越來越多人想加入。」現在菜園有四十位成員，從小學生到退休老人都有，每家照顧自己的一小塊地。
菜園帶給這條街的改變是蘿莎沒想到的。「有些人當了好多年鄰居，從來沒說過話，」她說，「現在大家分享種子、交換食譜，有人去度假時還會幫忙澆水。」去年夏天，成員們辦了第一次豐收派對，用自己種的東西做菜。
蘿莎下一步打算蓋一間小溫室，讓菜園冬天也能用。「我們得先籌點錢，」她說，「不過我們都走到這一步了，我相信一定有辦法。」

questions.q: What did Rosa miss when she moved?
questions.zh: 她最想念爸媽家的菜園：從小每年夏天都摘番茄、豆子。
questions.en: Her parents' garden: growing tomatoes and beans.

questions.q: What did the council tell Rosa?
options: She had to pay rent for the land.
The land could be used if it stayed tidy.
The land would be sold soon.
She could build a shed there.
questions.zh: 「只要我們保持整潔、不蓋永久的建築」就可以用。
questions.en: As long as it was kept tidy, with nothing permanent built.

questions.q: What happened in the first spring?
options: The group had to prepare the ground.
questions.zh: 第一個春天每個週末都在搬石頭、運土：整理土地。萵苣長出來後才有很多人加入。
questions.en: They cleared stones and brought soil; people joined later.

questions.q: How has the garden changed the street?
options: People go on holiday less often.
Neighbours now talk and help each other.
questions.zh: 以前不說話的鄰居現在分享種子、交換食譜、幫忙澆水。
questions.en: Neighbours share seeds and recipes and water plants.

options: to move to a bigger garden
questions.zh: 「下一步打算蓋一間小溫室」；豐收派對去年已經辦過了。
questions.en: A greenhouse; the harvest party already happened.

items.text:
Learning to swim at forty
I never learnt to swim as a child. My family lived far from the sea, and our town had no pool. (16) ＿＿＿＿＿ For years I made excuses whenever friends suggested a day at the beach.
Last year my daughter started swimming lessons, and I spent every Saturday watching her from the side of the pool. (17) ＿＿＿＿＿ So I decided it was time to learn too.
The first lesson was terrifying. I held on to the side and refused to put my face in the water. (18) ＿＿＿＿＿ She explained that being afraid was normal and that we would go at my speed.
Slowly, things improved. After a month I could float on my back, and after three months I swam my first length. (19) ＿＿＿＿＿
Now I swim twice a week before work. (20) ＿＿＿＿＿ My daughter and I are even planning to swim in the sea together this summer.
bank: Luckily, my teacher was very patient.
I was so proud that I nearly cried.
By the time I was an adult, I felt too embarrassed to start.
It's become the best part of my week.
I felt silly being the only parent who couldn't swim.
The pool was closed for the whole summer.
My daughter has never liked swimming.
I had always enjoyed water sports.

tr.zh:
四十歲學游泳
我小時候沒學過游泳。我家離海很遠，鎮上也沒有游泳池。等到長大成人，我已經不好意思開始學了。好多年來，朋友一提議去海邊，我就找藉口。
去年女兒開始上游泳課，我每個星期六都在池邊看她。全場只有我這個家長不會游泳，覺得很丟臉。於是我決定，自己也該學了。
第一堂課很可怕。我抓著池邊，不肯把臉放進水裡。幸好老師很有耐心。她說害怕很正常，我們會照我的速度來。
慢慢地，情況好轉了。一個月後我能仰漂，三個月後我游完了第一趟。我驕傲得差點哭出來。
現在我每週上班前游兩次，這成了我一週裡最快樂的時光。今年夏天，女兒和我甚至打算一起去海裡游泳。

questions.zh: 小時候沒機會學，接著說長大後「不好意思開始學」，所以才一直找藉口。
questions.en: Too embarrassed as an adult — hence the excuses.

questions.zh: 在池邊看女兒上課，覺得只有自己不會游泳很丟臉，「所以」決定也來學。
questions.en: The only parent who couldn't swim — so she decided to learn.

questions.zh: 後面的「她」是老師：「幸好老師很有耐心」，接著說老師怎麼安慰她。
questions.en: "She" is the patient teacher.

questions.zh: 游完第一趟，驕傲得差點哭出來。
questions.en: Her first length: so proud she nearly cried.

questions.zh: 現在每週游兩次，成了一週裡最快樂的時光。F、G、H 和文章意思不合，是多出來的。
questions.en: Swimming is now the best part of her week. F, G and H are extra.

items.text:
Why volunteer?
Volunteering is a great way to (21) ＿＿＿＿＿ new skills and meet people. Many young people think they don't have (22) ＿＿＿＿＿ free time, but even a few hours a month can make a real difference. You could work at an animal shelter, (23) ＿＿＿＿＿ older people with their shopping, or clean up a local beach. Before you choose, think about what you enjoy and what you are good (24) ＿＿＿＿＿. Some organisations ask volunteers to (25) ＿＿＿＿＿ a short training course first. Most importantly, volunteering should be fun, so don't be afraid to try something new if your first choice doesn't (26) ＿＿＿＿＿ out.

tr.zh:
為什麼要當志工？
當志工是學習新技能、認識新朋友的好方法。很多年輕人覺得自己空閒時間不夠，但其實每個月只要幾個小時，就能帶來真正的改變。你可以去動物收容所幫忙、幫老人家買東西，或是去附近的海灘淨灘。選擇之前，先想想自己喜歡什麼、擅長什麼。有些機構會要求志工先完成一個簡短的訓練課程。最重要的是，當志工應該要開心，所以如果第一個選擇不順利，不要怕嘗試新的事情。

questions.zh: 「learn new skills」：學新技能。
questions.en: learn new skills.

questions.zh: 「enough free time」：足夠的空閒時間；time 不可數，不能用 many / few。
questions.en: enough free time; time is uncountable.

questions.zh: 「help someone with something」：幫某人做某事。
questions.en: help older people with their shopping.

questions.zh: 「be good at」：擅長。
questions.en: good at.

questions.zh: 「complete a course」：完成課程。
questions.en: complete a training course.

questions.zh: 「work out」：（事情）順利、成功。
questions.en: doesn't work out.

items.text:
My grandfather's bike shop
My grandfather opened his bike shop in 1975, (27) ＿＿＿＿＿ makes it one of the oldest shops in our town. At first he only repaired bikes, but later he started selling them (28) ＿＿＿＿＿ well. When I was a child, I spent hours watching him work. He taught me how (29) ＿＿＿＿＿ change a tyre when I was only seven. Today the shop is run by my mother, and I help her (30) ＿＿＿＿＿ weekends. Business is good, because more people are cycling (31) ＿＿＿＿＿ ever before. My grandfather is ninety now, but he still comes in every morning (32) ＿＿＿＿＿ check that everything is in order.

tr.zh:
爺爺的腳踏車店
爺爺在1975年開了這家腳踏車店，是我們鎮上最老的店之一。一開始他只修車，後來也開始賣車。我小時候常常一看他工作就是好幾個小時。我才七歲時，他就教我怎麼換輪胎。現在店由媽媽經營，週末我會去幫忙。生意很好，因為騎腳踏車的人比以前任何時候都多。爺爺現在九十歲了，但他每天早上還是會來店裡，看看一切是否正常。

questions.zh: 「…, which makes it …」：which 指前面整件事（1975 年開店）。
questions.en: , which makes it — which refers to the whole clause.

questions.zh: 「as well」：也。
questions.en: as well (also).

questions.zh: 「how to change a tyre」：怎麼換輪胎。
questions.en: how to change a tyre.

questions.zh: 「at weekends」（英式）或「on weekends」：在週末。
questions.en: at (or on) weekends.

questions.zh: 「more … than ever before」：比以前任何時候都多。
questions.en: more … than ever before.

questions.zh: 「comes in … to check」：來是為了檢查，表示目的用 to。
questions.en: to check — purpose.
